summary_request: Summarise the news article below in at most three sentences for a daily briefing. Keep the main point and the key numbers. Use only facts from the article.

real.text: Randwick City Council has opened public consultation on introducing paid parking at beaches, citing non-local visitors making up as much as 84% of traffic at some beaches. The proposal is estimated to cost A$3.6 million to implement and generate A$6 million in annual revenue; consultation closes April 15. If approved, new signs and parking meters would be installed in late 2026 and 2027.
